lines.speaker: riku
lines.text: THE UPLOAD IS AT NINETY PERCENT [beat] AND WE CAN'T STOP IT NOW WITHOUT CRASHING THE ENTIRE SCHOOL NETWORK!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Look at the folder names [beat] they aren't just about the prom budget [beat] it says Project Stratosphere is funded by our tuition!

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: Step away from that terminal right now [beat] you have no idea what kind of legal fire you are playing with [beat] little boy!

lines.speaker: bruno
lines.text: Too late for that Principal Huda [beat] the whole student body just got a notification on their phones [beat] and they are not happy.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: It's showing receipts for a private luxury penthouse [beat] she didn't just steal prom money [beat] she stole the whole gym renovation fund too!

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: It was for the school's image [beat] I needed a place to meet high-level donors [beat] you are destroying our reputation for a few viral likes!

lines.speaker: joy
lines.text: A luxury penthouse is not a donor meeting room [beat] it has a gold-plated jacuzzi and three balconies overlooking the city!

lines.speaker: riku
lines.text: Wait [beat] the upload just hit one hundred percent [beat] but something weird is happening [beat] the files are being redirected to a secure server.

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: Did you really think I wouldn't have a fail-safe [beat] you just sent all that evidence directly to my private lawyers for deletion [beat] you lose!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: You are a snake Huda [beat] but you forgot one thing [beat] we weren't just uploading files [beat] we were live-streaming the entire folder to the cloud!

lines.speaker: bruno
lines.text: Wait Nix [beat] look at the screen [beat] there is a second folder hidden inside the stratosphere files [beat] it is labeled Kamal.

lines.speaker: kamal
lines.text: Nix [beat] I wouldn't open that file if I were you [beat] some secrets are buried deep for a very good reason [beat] walk away.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Mr. Kamal [beat] why is your name on a secret payroll document [beat] were you helping her hide the money this whole time?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The truth is more expensive than the prom [beat] and Mr. Kamal just became the primary suspect in the stratosphere scandal.
